name: kettlebell ipsilateral reverse lunge
description: A reverse lunge with the kettlebell on the same side as the front, working leg.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in one hand and keep that same-side leg planted in front.
Step backward with the opposite leg.
Lower under control while keeping your torso upright and front foot planted.
Push through the front foot to stand. Finish your reps, then switch hands and legs.
